$schema-note: Single source of truth for the visual system. Edit ONLY this file, then run `python design/generate.py`. Generated outputs are committed but never hand-edited — see docs/design-system.md.

ground.use: Page background. Near-black with a deliberate blue-green bias.

surface.use: Raised panels, the inference trace, cards.

ink.use: Primary text. Cool off-white, never pure #FFF.

signal.use: The one accent. Live state, focus rings, links. Spend boldness here and nowhere else.

layerBrowser.use: Inference on the visitor's own device. COOL pole.

layerEdge.use: Inference at Cloudflare, near the visitor. COOL pole.

layerServer.use: Inference on the Brisbane VM. WARM pole.

layerCloud.use: Inference at the Anthropic API. WARM pole.

ok.use: Semantic only — success states. Not an accent.

danger.use: Semantic only — errors and failed validation.

mono.value: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Cascadia Mono', monospace
mono.use: Headings, labels, all data. The terminal signature.

sans.use: Running text only. No webfont anywhere — a CDN that fails silently is worse than a system face.

fast.use: Hover, focus, colour shifts. Interaction feedback must feel instant.

base.use: Ceiling for interaction feedback — state changes the visitor caused.

entrance.use: Scroll and load entrances. These are travel, not feedback, so they need room to read as movement rather than a flicker.

stagger.use: Delay step between siblings in a cascade. Multiplied by index.

easing.use: Decelerating. Precise, never bouncy — no overshoot, no spring.

rise.use: How far an element climbs on entrance. Big enough to read as movement across a screen.

slide.use: Horizontal entrance distance for rows and labels.

drift.use: Continuous scroll-linked parallax distance. The differential between elements is the effect.

sharp.use: Everything. Instrument panel, not a rounded card.
